query:
UPDATE image_version SET current = TRUE
            WHERE version = (
                SELECT prev.version
                FROM image_version curr
                JOIN image_version prev
                    ON prev.image_id = curr.image_id
                WHERE curr.image_id = $1
                    AND curr.version = $2
                    AND prev.ts < curr.ts
                ORDER BY prev.ts DESC LIMIT 1
            )
            RETURNING version
